coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the seven-variable-category level, 3 of 7 categories match: training regime, contrasting game rules, and gameplay outcomes (43%). Evaluation controls and reasoning measures overlap only partially with the ground truth.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B with a fixed Llama-3-8B model. It does not include the specified learning-rate and KL-coefficient comparisons involving Alpaca SFT. Batch size is 64 rather than 128, and maximum sequence length 2048 is omitted. Most required reasoning benchmarks are missing, and a standardized Overall Reasoning Index replaces the geometric mean. Shared evaluation procedures and some benchmark scores are present but do not fully match the specified categories.
